rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium displays near-total melanin saturation, with dark pixels covering approximately 98-100% of the visible apex; no pink or pale depigmentation zones are detectable at this resolution.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent vertical tuft of mane hair located on the sagittal crest of the skull; distinct dark-pigmented borders visible on the posterior edges of the pinnae.
